name: lintbrain-status
description: Shows in the prompt footer when your Extended Brain vault was last linted, and hints when it is time to run /LintBrain.

vaultPath.title: Vault path
vaultPath.description: Absolute path of your Extended Brain vault, the folder that holds the .lintbrain file. A leading ~ is allowed. Left empty, the EXTENDED_BRAIN_PATH environment variable is used.

staleAfterDays.title: Stale after (days)
staleAfterDays.description: From how many days without a lint run the footer adds the /LintBrain hint.
